name: The Vineyard
source: Dana is trapped in a loveless marriage, struggling to keep the family business from going under, and just when she thinks things can't get any worse, her father announces his retirement as CEO. He requests a Bacchanalian themed send off.  The party is a hit but things take a horrific turn for the worst and it's up to Dana to put an end to the chaos.
translation: 达娜陷入了无爱的婚姻，努力避免家族企业破产，正当她认为事情不能变得更糟时，她的父亲宣布从首席执行官的职位上退休。他要求以酒神节为主题的送行。派对很受欢迎，但事情却发生了可怕的最坏的转变，达纳必须结束混乱。
